scholarships.title: Beca de Articulación (BAR)
scholarships.official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile

eligibility: Be a graduate (egresada) or holder (titulada) of a higher technical programme completed during 2025 or 2026
Within the 70% most vulnerable group according to the Registro Social de Hogares
Enrol at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026
Not have received a Mineduc tuition scholarship as a first-year student on two separate occasions
existing.eligibility_summary: People who graduated from or completed a higher technical programme during 2025 or 2026 and want to continue into a professional degree, who come from the 70% most vulnerable households according to the Registro Social de Hogares and have a secondary-school average of 5.0 or above.
benefits: Up to CLP 750,000 per year towards the annual tuition of the continuation degree
Awarded for the full regulatory duration of the degree
coverage: Up to CLP 750,000 of the annual tuition, financing all or part of it
requirements: File the application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estudiantiles using RUT or ClaveÚnica
Prove that the technical programme was completed in 2025 or 2026
Enrol at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026
For Medicine, Dentistry or Pedagogy, the degree itself must also be accredited
Do not apply to distance, semi-presential, special titulación, postgraduate or post-degree programmes, or to any programme the institution defines as a special study plan
documents: Evidence of completing the technical programme in 2025 or 2026
Proof of enrolment at an accredited institution
application_method: Online application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estudiantiles
Results checked on the Beneficios Estudiantiles site
existing.selection_notes: The official page does not publish ranking criteria; the benefit is granted on the basis of FUAS data plus State records.
existing.best_fit: Low-income Chilean graduates of a 2025 or 2026 higher technical programme who want to complete a professional degree without a tuition gap.
existing.notes: The award is notable for covering the whole regulatory length of the continuation degree rather than a single year. Programme-type exclusions are strict: distance, semi-presential, special titulación, postgraduate and post-degree programmes are all out of scope, as is anything the institution designates a special study plan.
existing.duration: The full regulatory length of the degree programme, per the curriculum each institution publishes annually. The period of titulación and professional or work placements does not count unless it is part of the curriculum.
existing.application_period: 1 to 22 October 2026 for the 2027 admission cycle (official wording: "Postulación: del 1 al 22 de octubre 2026"), filed through the FUAS website.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2027 admission cycle close on 22 October 2026.
